Golden baseline of the scripts the spec-location migration moves onto the
resolver, with every new option unset (custom-spec-location REQ-H1.1).

CAPTURED FROM THE PRE-MIGRATION SCRIPTS at commit 821fb2f, by
`tests/test-spec-location-golden.sh --record-probes`. DO NOT REGENERATE from a
later tree: a migration task that changes a probe's output declares the new
output under changes/task-<id>.txt, against a correction registered in
corrections.tsv, and that declaration is what review reads.

The config-get and convergence-steps records probe the convergence step list,
which replaced the review-sequence knob and its resolver after this capture.
They were recorded from 821fb2f's scripts like the rest, less the one line
that commit's core layer printed as a stale-key warning for the retired
review_sequence key; that warning is the knob's retirement, not a
spec-location change.

Recordings that stand out as the corrections they will become: config-get,
convergence-steps and config-knob from the worktree miss the primary checkout's
machine-local values; overlay-repo-root-override takes a repo-root override
that is not a git toplevel as given; rule-doc-contentless-arm returns the
self-location arm with no warning; and dispatch-worktree from the worktree
places the task worktree under the worktree rather than the primary checkout.

Commit ids and anchors are normalized to <SHA>: the anchors part of the test
pins the anchor function, so the probes need not.

Format: everything above the first `@@ ` line is commentary; each record is a
`@@ <probe> <vantage>` header followed by the probe's normalized output and its
exit status.
